changeRecord.title: fixed (or partially fixed) support made pinned
changeRecord.target: support C1.0: rotation(s) rx, rz freed (ry kept)
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A fixed base takes moment and restrains the column end; a pinned base does not. Pinning it removes the base moment, roughly doubles the effective length of a sway column, and moves the moment to the other end of the member and into the beams; the frame becomes markedly more flexible.
changeRecord.precondition: a support with a fixed or sprung rotation (other than the plane restraint of a plane frame)
